tools.name: find_jobs
tools.description:
Marketplace job postings: search them by keywords and filters, get one by id, or get the jobs recommended for the freelancer's own profile (smart_search).
Actions: search, get, smart_search.
get: params.id (numeric id, ~02 ciphertext or job URL). search: params.title, params.sort, params.limit; results are in jobs. smart_search: params.mode, params.days_posted or params.from_date.
